dict.string: While the Manager page is open, the helper reads your library (Downloads by default: Manager_Files and the hidden .manager index) and looks for new HTML files. When you import, it writes search details and a thumbnail, moves the file into the library and updates the index. It moves files to the Trash only after you confirm.

If you keep your Manager library or new-files folder on an external disk, the helper reads Manager_Files, the .manager index and thumbnails there, and updates them when you import or confirm a deletion.
